turns.replyText:
I've been disappointed by similar products before, so quality really matters to me.

I hear you, and that makes total sense. When you’ve been let down before, it’s stressful to risk it again.

At Heirloom, a few things we do are specifically about quality:

We grow all of our roses ourselves at our nurseries in Oregon (we don’t buy from third-party growers).
Our roses are premium own-root plants in 1-gallon containers, not bare root, so you start with a well-developed root system.
Every rose is covered by a one-year guarantee, and our garden advisors are here to help troubleshoot if something doesn’t perform how you expect.

I want to make sure we pick something that really fits your situation. Could you tell me:

Your hardiness zone or zip code?
